# Deepanshu Sagore

> AI engineer based in Indore, India, working on generative AI and retrieval-augmented generation. Builds LLM-powered applications across the whole path, from document parsing and embeddings through retrieval pipelines and prompt design, and evaluates model output against structured rubrics. Winner of the Google AI Hackathon (AIPL).

Deepanshu works the GenAI path end to end rather than one slice of it: parsing and chunking documents, generating embeddings, standing up retrieval pipelines, designing prompts, then measuring whether the answers that come back are actually grounded in what was retrieved. Six months at Outlier were spent on the evaluation side of that, writing coding tasks and edge cases built to expose failure modes in advanced models and scoring their output against detailed rubrics.

## Experience

- Coding Specialist at Outlier (Feb 2026 – Aug 2026): AI training and evaluation across Multimodal SWE and Multi-Bench. Reviewed and tested AI-generated code on single-turn and multi-turn tasks for correctness, reasoning, instruction following and engineering quality; wrote hard coding tasks and edge cases to expose model failure modes; scored outputs against detailed rubrics and wrote the structured feedback that went back into training.
- LLM Post Trainer at Ethara.ai (Nov 2025 – Feb 2026): reviewed, corrected and optimised model responses; annotated datasets and wrote structured feedback against alignment and performance goals; wrote and evaluated prompts testing reasoning, creativity and factual correctness.
- SMM and Graphic Designer at Maica Plastiwood (Apr 2023 – Apr 2024): ran the Instagram account, dealing directly with creators and prospective investors, wrote the product copy, and designed the posts and reels the products appeared in.

## Skills

- AI: LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, embeddings, LLM evaluation, Hugging Face.
- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++.
- Frameworks: FastAPI, Next.js, React.js, PyTorch, Sentence-Transformers, Node.js, Express.js.
- Libraries: NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Transformers, Matplotlib.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, ChromaDB, MongoDB, MySQL, Supabase.
- Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, OpenCode.

## Projects

- [Ethara](https://ethara-snowy.vercel.app): Seat allocation and project mapping for roughly 5,000 employees, with analytics dashboards and a natural-language assistant.
- [NeuroNest](https://github.com/DeepanshuSagore): RAG application that grounds every answer in retrieved document passages to cut hallucinations. LangChain, ChromaDB, Python.
- [FinTrack AI](https://fintrack-finai.vercel.app): Budget and spend tracker with receipt scanning, budget monitoring and automated email summaries. Next.js, PostgreSQL.
- [Aligna](https://alignafr.vercel.app): AI talent scouting that parses job descriptions and ranks candidates through a weighted matching model.
- [DriveFlow](https://drive-dusky-omega.vercel.app): Real-time lead management CRM with automated scoring and a drag-and-drop pipeline.
- [EventsHub](https://eventshub-tan.vercel.app/): Two-sided campus marketplace where departments list events and students register, gated by an admin moderation queue and role-aware dashboards.
- [Support Ticket Classifier](https://github.com/DeepanshuSagore/ethara-interview-assignment): Sorts support requests into six categories, assigns a priority and recommends the next action.
- [HackFinder](https://hack-finder-omega.vercel.app/): Hackathon team matching by skill and requirement.
- [AIPL](https://cric-os.vercel.app): In-character conversations with cricket personalities, driven by a language model. Next.js, TypeScript.
- [IPL Co-Host AI](https://ipl-cohost.vercel.app): A live companion for an IPL match, delivering real-time insight, prediction and match intelligence while the game runs.
- [StickyYT](https://github.com/DeepanshuSagore/Sticky-YT): Full-stack YouTube tracker. Next.js route handlers over MongoDB, Firebase Google sign-in, Three.js background.
- [Frites](https://fritesfr.vercel.app): A brand site carried entirely by type, motion and art direction.
- [Vaultic](https://vaulticfr.vercel.app): Tabs and sites you actually reuse, filed under categories instead of buried in a bookmark tree.
- [DevRoad](https://dev-road-beta.vercel.app): Roadmap tracker for developers.
- [This portfolio](https://github.com/DeepanshuSagore/portfolio): React 19 and Vite, prerendered to static HTML, anime.js loaded lazily and never under reduced motion.
